about: The answer key for the documents-map samples: the proposals a correct run makes from trace.json on a graph whose ontology is sampleOntology of samples.ts (Station, Part, ManualSection; HAS_PART from Station to Part, DESCRIBED_IN from Station to ManualSection) and that holds no instance of them yet.
All text is invented. Entries are named by their document and identifier; a station is a page entry made from the station sheet's own number in the head of its page.

instances: each entry a link needs is a new instance of its class, proposed as four statements: its rdf:type, its rdfs:label, its identifier, and the DENOTES link from its entry (a DocEntry, or the DocMention of a station number).

facts: each link of the trace is one statement from the station of its page to the instance of the entry it names, 15 in all. A correct run makes these 15 facts and no other: 75 proposals with the 60 statements of the instances.
leave_out: what a correct run does not propose.
